title: Enforcement Decree of the Korea Tourism Organization Act
full_text:
Enforcement Decree of the Korea Tourism Organization Act

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Korea Tourism Organization Act and matters necessary for the enforcement thereof.

Article 2 (Registration of Establishment)
(1) The Korea Tourism Organization (hereinafter referred to as the "Organization") shall complete registration of establishment under Article 5 of the Korea Tourism Organization Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") at the location of its principal office within two weeks from the date it obtains authorization of its articles of incorporation.
(2) The matters to be registered under paragraph (1) shall be as follows:
1. Purpose;
2. Name;
3. Location of the principal office, branch offices, or offices;
4. Capital;
5. Names and addresses of executive officers;
6. Method of public notice.

Article 3 (Registration of Establishment of Branch Offices, etc.)
Where the Organization establishes a branch office or office, it shall, within two weeks after establishment, register the name, location, and date of establishment of the branch office or office at the location of its principal office.

Article 4 (Registration of Relocation)
(1) Where the Organization relocates its principal office, it shall, within two weeks after relocation, register the new location and the date of relocation at the former location or the new location.
(2) Where the Organization relocates a branch office or office, it shall, within two weeks after relocation, register the new location and date of relocation at the location of its principal office.

Article 5 (Registration of Changes)
Where any registered matter under any subparagraph of Article 2 (2) or Article 3 changes, except where it constitutes registration of relocation under Article 4, the Organization shall register the changed matter at the location of its principal office within two weeks after the change.

Article 6 (Registration of Appointment of Agent)
Where the president of the Organization appoints an agent pursuant to Article 10 of the Act, the Organization shall, within two weeks after the appointment, register the following matters at the location of its principal office: <Amended on January 21, 2025>
1. Name and address of the agent;
2. Name and location of the principal office, branch office, or office for which the agent is appointed;
3. Details of any restriction on the agent's authority.

Article 7 (Documents Attached to Applications for Registration)
An application for registration under this Decree shall be accompanied by the following documents:
1. Registration of establishment under Article 2: The articles of incorporation of the Organization, documents proving the qualifications of executive officers, and minutes of meetings of the establishment committee;
2. Registration of establishment of a branch office or office under Article 3: Documents proving such establishment;
3. Registration of relocation under Article 4: Documents proving relocation of the principal office, branch office, or office;
4. Registration of changes under Article 5: Documents proving the relevant changes;
5. Registration of appointment of an agent under Article 6: Documents proving the appointment of the agent;
6. Registration of issuance of corporate bonds under Article 11: Documents proving that a resolution of the board of directors under Article 15 (1) of the Act has been adopted.

Article 8 (Calculation of Registration Period)
Where any matter to be registered under this Decree requires authorization or approval of the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the registration period under Articles 2 through 5 shall be calculated from the date on which the relevant authorization or approval document is received.

Article 9 (Entrusted Management)
(1) "Another person" under Article 12 (2) of the Act means a public organization, public-interest corporation, or organization recognized by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism.
(2) Where the Organization intends to entrust its business to a corporation or organization under paragraph (1) pursuant to Article 12 (2) of the Act, it shall obtain a resolution of the board of directors regarding the type and scope of business to be entrusted, the conditions and period of entrusted management, the method of entrustment, and other relevant matters.

Article 9-2 (Scope of Public Organizations)
"Institutions prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 12 (3) of the Act means the following:
1. Local government-directly operated enterprises under Article 5 of the Local Public Enterprises Act, local public corporations under Article 49 of the same Act, and local public agencies under Article 76 of the same Act;
2. Institutions invested in or contributed to by local governments designated by the Minister of the Interior and Safety pursuant to Article 5 of the Act on the Operation of Local Government-Invested or -Funded Institutions.

Article 10 (Transfer of Reserves to Capital)
Where the Organization intends to transfer all or part of its reserves to capital pursuant to Article 13 (3) of the Act, it shall obtain a resolution of the general meeting of shareholders.

Article 11 (Registration of Issuance of Corporate Bonds)
Where the Organization issues corporate bonds pursuant to Article 15 (1) of the Act, it shall register the following matters: <Amended on July 2, 2019>
1. Purpose of issuing the corporate bonds;
2. Timing of issuance;
3. Total amount of corporate bonds;
4. Face value of each denomination of corporate bonds;
5. Interest rate;
6. Method of offering and underwriting;
7. Method and maturity of redemption;
8. Method and due date for payment of interest.

Article 12 (Standards for Imposition of Administrative Fines)
The standards for imposing administrative fines under Article 19 (1) of the Act shall be as specified in the attached Table.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 11970, September 23, 1986>

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Culture and Sports and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 14442, December 23, 1994>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso Omitted>

Article 2
Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (6) Omitted.

(7) The Enforcement Decree of the Korea Tourism Organization Act shall be amended as follows:

In Article 8 and Article 9 (1), respectively, "Minister of Transportation" shall be replaced with "Minister of Culture and Sports."

(8) Omitted.

ADDENDUM (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 20676, February 29, 2008>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through <32> Omitted.

<33> The Enforcement Decree of the Korea Tourism Organization Act shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 8 and Article 9 (1), respectively, "Minister of Culture and Sports" shall be replaced with "Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism."

<34> through <37> Omitted.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 23405, December 28, 2011>

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 28871, May 8, 2018>

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDUM (Presidential Decree on Partial Amendment of 210 Presidential Decrees for Improvement of Difficult Legal Terminology) <Presidential Decree No. 29950, July 2, 2019>
